acceptanceCriteria: A non-zero runner exit is never recorded as a durable terminal success
A PID probe that fails for permission reasons is not treated as evidence the process died
A failure to persist monitor state is surfaced rather than silently dropping the monitor while the session still looks active
A corrupt or unreadable worktree registry is reported, never silently replaced by an empty one that orphans existing worktrees
Watchdog coverage includes a non-zero exit, which it does not today
deliverables: src/runner/watchdog.ts: honour the child exit code, distinguish a permission error from a dead process, and stop swallowing persistence failures
src/git/worktree.ts loadStore: distinguish a genuinely absent registry from a corrupt or unreadable one
Tests for a non-zero exit, a permission-denied PID probe, and a corrupt registry
title: Stop the watchdog and worktree registry from converting failures into plausible values
